description: Rothco’s Canvas Briefcase Backpack combines durability and versatility, offering 3 ways to carry: hideaway backpack straps, a removable shoulder strap, and sturdy carry handles. Crafted from heavyweight cotton canvas with a polyester-lined interior, this multifunctional bag is perfect for work, travel, or everyday use. The spacious design includes 2 main compartments, with 1 featuring a padded laptop compartment secured by a hook and loop closure. 3 outer zippered pockets provide additional storage, including a large pocket with an internal divider. Magnetic button closure pockets add a touch of convenience. Measuring 17 inch x 12 inch x 6.5 inch, this bag adapts to your needs, whether as a briefcase or backpack. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
